summary: Restored branch_orders on node1 using MySQL 5.0.45, preserving supplied keys, relationships, DECIMAL values, and the original export. The password-protected reporting account works from node2 with SELECT-only access, while root retains write access. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs.

Verified remote reads and denied UPDATE/DELETE operations from node2.
Verified administrator writes using transactions followed by rollback.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified persistent recovery.
